overview_description.description:
Searchie is a virtual video interview platform for recruitment companies. The virtual video interview platform which will cut down-time and cost to hire by 80%. It helps employers to virtual interview, screen, and shortlist candidates. The recruiter creates their company profile on the Searchie platform and gives some valuable information about the company culture, behavioral traits and competencies and provides 3-5 job-related screening questions.

Searchie combines human intelligence and artificial intelligence to provide employers with a fast solution that cuts the time and cost to hire. It enables employers to do everything from creating a job and tracking its progress to viewing video interviews with the recruiters and scheduling the face to face interviews in one place.

Searchie was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
